instr: Machine steps: learn how to operate a made-up machine from written steps, then operate it from memory.
clue: First read the steps for operating a machine and the worked example; you have up to 45 seconds. Then the steps disappear and you operate the machine three times from memory: look at the lamp colour and the number, press the buttons in the right order (click, tap, or keys 1-8), then press Done (Enter). Undo (Backspace) removes your last press. Press Start when ready.
example: Worked example: for this machine, the correct presses are:
step_cond: If the lamp is {c}, press {a}; otherwise press {b}.
step_repeat: Press {a} as many times as the number on the display.
